label: AI build-out
description: The money and machinery behind AI: data-center capex, how it is financed, the power it needs, the chips and memory it runs on, and what the AI labs earn.

label: The Fed and rates
description: Federal Reserve policy and the price of money: rate decisions, inflation, the Treasury market, the deficit and how much the government has to borrow.

label: Credit
description: Who is struggling to pay: credit spreads, defaults, private credit and direct lending, leveraged loans, downgrades and bankruptcies.

label: Seattle and Washington
description: The local economy: Seattle-area employers and hiring, layoffs and WARN notices, housing and commercial real estate, and Washington state budgets and taxes.

label: Special situations
description: Corporate events that move a stock on their own: spin-offs, mergers and acquisitions, tender offers, buybacks, activist stakes and proxy fights.

label: Energy
description: Oil, natural gas and electricity: supply, prices, OPEC, LNG, the power grid, utilities and the electricity demand from data centers.

label: Markets
description: The big picture for portfolios: stock valuations, fund flows and positioning, earnings season, the dollar, volatility, and the major macro calls (recession, soft landing, bubble).
